opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme

amount.raw: Fellowships provide temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements with financial support from a Network of 135 universities and research institutes; 2- or 3-year awards as standard. No specific monetary figure stated.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death.
opportunities.summary: Cara's core rescue programme provides academics in immediate danger with temporary placements (postdoctoral or PhD) at universities and research institutions in the UK and elsewhere, including help with visa processes and practical arrangements for them and their families. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
